component.name: Godnotic
component.summary: Arena FPS fork with faster loads, leaner assets and a native-first interface

description.p: Godnotic is an independent fork of the Xonotic arena shooter and its DarkPlaces engine. It exists to make the game itself better: faster loads, leaner assets, and an interface that is native-first on each platform instead of one compromise shared by all of them.

Touch is part of that story, not the whole of it. The on-screen controls appear when a touchscreen is present, step aside for a keyboard and a mouse, and follow the window as it changes shape, in any orientation.

The Flatpak is small at install. Maps, textures and music download on first launch: about 390 MB of ASTC packs where the GPU supports them, about 1 GB otherwise. Updates stay small because they carry the game, not the data.
The same game also ships for Android (APK, with in-place updates through AndySU), for Ubuntu Touch (OpenStore), and in the browser as a WebAssembly build that needs no install at all.
Flatpak-first distribution with runtime asset download and automated CI releases.
